title: The Pentagon
blurb: Headquarters of the US Department of Defense: five concentric pentagonal rings, A to E, around a five-acre courtyard, joined by ten radial corridors. Built in about 16 months during 1941 to 1943, its Indiana limestone walls hold about 6.5 million sq ft of floor space, among the largest office buildings in the world.

sourceUrls.label: Virginia DHR: Pentagon National Register nomination

systems.name: Concentric rings
systems.description: The five concentric pentagonal rings, A (innermost) through E (outermost): their walls, floor plates, window strips, parapets and the light-well floors between them.

systems.name: Radial corridors
systems.description: The ten radial corridors, numbered 1 to 10, that join the A ring to the E ring on every floor, plus the pedestrian bridge from corridor 2 toward the Metro.

systems.name: Central courtyard
systems.description: The five-acre pentagonal courtyard at the heart of the building, nicknamed "ground zero". Planting and paths are schematic.

systems.name: Limestone facades
systems.description: The Indiana limestone skin of the outer walls and the five entrance porticoes with their terraces. Portico and terrace shapes are schematic.

systems.name: Entrance halls
systems.description: The five entrance lobbies, their security pavilions, the second-floor concourse mall and the Metro station hall. Interiors are schematic.

systems.name: Roofs
systems.description: Crosshipped slate roofs over the inner (A) and outer (E) rings and the connector corridors; flat built-up decks over the three middle rings. Slopes are schematic.

systems.name: Basement levels
systems.description: The B and M levels below ground, a sample of the 41,492 concrete piles, retaining walls and the concrete access ramps. Depths are schematic.

systems.name: Grounds and roads
systems.description: The reservation around the building: parking lots, access roads, the lagoon, the heliport pad, lawns and the security fence. All schematic.

systems.name: Building services
systems.description: Heating and refrigeration plants, stair and lift cores and roof plant rooms. All schematic.

systems.name: Pentagon memorial
systems.description: The September 11 memorial on the west side of the building. Layout is schematic.
